description: This Python script sets up a speech processing bot using Speechmatics STT/TTS, OpenAI LLM, and Pipecat pipeline framework. It configures speech diarization, voice activity detection, and integrates multiple services for a conversational AI application.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents a sequence of processing steps for the speech bot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with parameters and timeout settings.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for a pipeline execution.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of a pipeline, including signal handling.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds the context/messages for the language model interactions.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Aggregates user and assistant responses for LLM context management.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregatorParams
classes.description: Parameters for user response aggregation in LLM context.

classes.name: BaseOpenAILLMService
classes.description: Base class for OpenAI LLM services.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the speech processing pipeline with specified transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, creates transport and initiates run_bot.
